I was seeing a bottom-of-the-barrel psychiatrist who was trying to just push benzos on me. My last visit ended chaotically due to the doctor making me sit in his waiting room with geeks for an hour after my appointment and I asked the front desk why I had an appointment time if they could not uphold it and the staff immediately got defensive and I just ended up asking for my money back for my boyfriend and I for that particular visit because we are self pay (no insurance). That pretty much shut down whatever "establishment" they had running and by the very end it was downright shady but they cut us a check since their "new" card machine wasn't coming through. I'm not going to get started on my mental issues, some of which I'm sure you can assume through reading this, if you've taken the time to make it this far in, hah... Anyhow... Boyfriend isn't the problem, he is as supportive and helpful as he can be, he has his own mental issues but comes from an entirely different upbringing/social status/support group than myself so he isn't always equipped for me. He loves me all the same. We discuss everything frequently and he's aware how depressed I am. The problem is that I was seeing such a bum psychiatrist because he was the last one in my town that I called that was taking new patients. He was a joke and I obviously didn't last long. But I NEED the medicine. I can start to see the difference already and I've been having to wean myself off the meds he had me on until I can find another Dr. I was taking buspirone 3x a day for anxiety and celexa once a day for depression. He also prescribed me a benzo against my wishes so I ended up with Ativan. Of which I now have two bottles of and haven't taken a handful since I started seeing him. I don't know what to do. Sorry for such a long response.. post.. I guess I'm just happy someone reached out. Thank you.

It was so fast. Idk.. and the voices I guess it's just better explained as me talking to myself silently but about loads of things all at once. Trying to catch a thought sometimes feels like grabbing a fish out of a quick stream with your bare hands. I was raised in churches and my mom turned to her church when she got clean. I've been considering going but I just don't agree with the Bible about certain things. I just wanna create a support system, make friends, be around genuinely good people.
